|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 20 September 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “Once during your control phase, may ▲ (or lose 1 Force to retrieve) Local Trouble or Look Sir, Droids. Opponent may not fire weapons in Local Trouble battles.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Trooper Davin Felth (V) (Virtual Set 3) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 3: Revolution, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “During your control phase, may take (or lose 1 Force to retrieve) one Local Trouble or Look Sir, Droids into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Opponent may not fire weapons during Local Trouble battles.” '''What changed:''' “Once during” → “During”; “▲” → “take”; added “one”; “Droids.” → “Droids into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”; “in” → “during”.
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards3.pdf#page=4 VirtualCards3.pdf] — the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown); page 4, slip 49. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Trooper Davin Felth]].
* Later text: [[Trooper Davin Felth (V) (Virtual Set 3) (Errata)]] (the 4 December 2006 remaster).
|hatnote=Other versions of this Virtual Original card: [[Trooper Davin Felth (V) (Virtual Set 3) (Errata)]]. For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[Trooper Davin Felth]].
